subject: general
question:
Which one of the following is not an input device?

A. Web Camera

B. BCR

C. Digitizer

D. Processor
solution:
The correct answer is __**Processor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **processor**, also known as the **Central Processing Unit(CPU), provides the instructions and processing power the computer needs to do its work. **
 
• A** "processor", or "microprocessor," is a small chip that resides in computers and other electronic devices**.
 
• Its basic **job is to receive input and provide the appropriate output. While this may seem like a simple task, modern processors can handle trillions of calculations per second**.
 
• The **more powerful and updated your processor, the faster your computer can complete its tasks**.
 
• There are five **types** of general-purpose **processors** they are,
 
 
• Microcontroller.
 
• Microprocessor.
 
• Embedded Processor. 
 
• DSP. 
 
• Media Processor.
